verdict.rationale: Shopify Tax documentation describes automated US sales tax calculation, liability insights, and automated filing and remittance in the admin, which covers the calculation and filing parts of the story for US merchants. The evidence is explicitly scoped to the United States and never mentions VAT or non-US jurisdictions. missing for 10: VAT/international tax calculation, explicit evidence that rates are kept current, detail on jurisdiction-level reports, independent or hands-on corroboration.
